subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort { key, clearQueued: true }` become the supported public Gateway contract for deliberately discarding a selected non-global session's queued followup and lane work?
rationale: This is an additive but destructive protocol capability affecting queued message delivery and session lifecycle; tests can prove the implementation, but cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term API policy.

options.title: Approve the opt-in queue-clear contract
options.body: Keep `clearQueued` as documented, preserve omission compatibility for all existing callers, and merge after a current-base refresh.

options.title: Use a narrower owner-specific mechanism
options.body: Keep ordinary `sessions.abort` run/session cancellation semantics unchanged and introduce a dedicated Control UI or owner-scoped path if public queue discard is not desired.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not merge the branch if the product should never let a client discard queued session work through Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in queue-clear contract
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued` as documented, preserve omission compatibility for all existing callers, and merge after a current-base refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the visible implementation and proof context, although a Gateway/session owner should make the API-policy decision.
